message.content:
This document is a technical README and set of engineering notes for **Project Maya**, an open-source inference engine for large MoE models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash). Key technical points:

**Architecture & Models**
- GLM-5.3-Flash: 320B params (18B active), 45 layers, 3:1 KDA linear-attention / DSA-MLA hybrid, mHC 4-stream residuals, 288 experts top-8, MTP layer, 1
